candidate_attempt_rule: There are five candidate slots shared across all K targets. Each may use at most one new real tactical CLI and one fixed full-stage simulation. Contract or static failures retain the slot; only STARTED processes and simulations count against their applicable limits.
counting_rule: Count each real tactical CLI process and each fixed full-stage simulation at STARTED, including failures and timeouts. A WIN freezes that candidate and updates the next target to N-1; continue only while total M71 slots remain. No automatic retry, resume, replacement call, historical balance transfer, or sixth candidate.
non_stackable: M70 ended at candidate attempts 1/5, CLI 1/5, and simulation 1/5; its remaining balances do not transfer to M71. M70 V1 remains the frozen 8-ID WIN until a smaller-ID M71 WIN is verified.
